scope.calendar_scope: NYSE cash equities core RTH context

regular_session_convention.basis: Current official NYSE page states the core trading session is 9:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. ET. The research convention uses that interval for cash RTH context; this evidence does not independently certify every historical venue or data-vendor status.

local_reference.local_reference_note: The local config is the admitted reference byte set. Official page URLs and publication dates are retained below; no claim is made that an official HTML/PDF byte capture is immutable in this evidence file.

known_at_policy.method: Conservative end of the official publication date in New York, represented as the following civil day at 00:00:00 America/New_York.
known_at_policy.publication_time: Not supplied by the official release pages; intraday availability is therefore not claimed.
known_at_policy.cut_comparison: A release is usable only when its derived known_at is at or before the observation cut. CashCalendar.resolve selects the newest eligible release for the requested year.

official_sources.title: NYSE Group Announces 2019, 2020 and 2021 Holiday and Early Closings Calendar
official_sources.authority: Intercontinental Exchange / NYSE Group official press release
official_sources.page_evidence: The official table lists the 2020 and 2021 closed dates; its footnotes specify 13:00 ET early close on the day after Thanksgiving for both years and 13:00 ET on 2020-12-24.
official_sources.selection_role: Earliest retained official reference for both requested years; use when a historical cut precedes the 2019 release.

official_sources.title: NYSE Group Announces 2020, 2021 and 2022 Holiday and Early Closings Calendar
official_sources.authority: Intercontinental Exchange / NYSE Group official press release
official_sources.page_evidence: The official table republishes the 2020 and 2021 closures; the footnotes specify 13:00 ET on 2020-11-27 and 2021-11-26, and 13:00 ET on 2020-12-24.
official_sources.selection_role: Preferred latest official release for 2020/2021 observations whose cut is on or after this known-at boundary.

official_sources.title: NYSE Group Announces 2026, 2027 and 2028 Holiday and Early Closings Calendar
official_sources.authority: Intercontinental Exchange / NYSE Group official press release
official_sources.page_evidence: The official 2026 table lists the ten closed dates; its footnotes specify 13:00 ET on 2026-11-27 and 2026-12-24.
official_sources.selection_role: Preferred official release for 2026; it was known before the 2026 observation year.

official_sources.selection_role: Already represented by the local override and retained as a required exception.

official_sources.title: Holidays & Trading Hours
official_sources.page_evidence: The page states the 2026-2028 holiday table and the NYSE Tape A core session of 9:30 a.m. to 4:00 p.m. ET.

official_sources.title: 2026 Trading Calendar
official_sources.page_evidence: The PDF legend identifies exchange holidays as market closed and early market closes at 1 p.m. Eastern; its date note says the calendar was correct as of 2025-12-10 and subject to change.

calendar_extension.date_encoding: MM-DD suffixes under the named year; all early closes are local New York wall time.
calendar_extension.early_close_convention: 13:00:00 America/New_York for NYSE cash equities; the releases mention 13:15 ET for eligible options, which is outside this cash-equity scope.

notes: July 3 is the observed Independence Day closure because July 4, 2020 was Saturday.
No Juneteenth closure appears in the official 2020/2021 NYSE tables; do not add one retroactively from later calendars.
July 5 is the observed Independence Day closure because July 4, 2021 was Sunday.
December 24 is the observed Christmas closure; it is not an early-close date.
No Juneteenth closure appears in the official 2020/2021 NYSE tables; do not add one retroactively from later calendars.
July 3 is the observed Independence Day closure because July 4, 2026 is Saturday.
Juneteenth is a full closure on June 19, 2026.
The current 2026-09-07 date is Labor Day; dates after the latest acquired observation must remain future schedule facts until actual data receipt is established.

errors_or_gaps_in_current_calendar.finding: The admitted config has no 2020 year table. CashCalendar.resolve cannot produce a 2020 CashDay at a 2020 or later cut because no eligible release contains that year.
errors_or_gaps_in_current_calendar.repair_needed: Add the 2018-12-04 and 2019-12-09 official release lineage, with the latest eligible release selected by cut.

errors_or_gaps_in_current_calendar.finding: The admitted config has no 2021 year table. CashCalendar.resolve cannot produce a 2021 CashDay at a 2021 or later cut because no eligible release contains that year.
errors_or_gaps_in_current_calendar.repair_needed: Add the 2018-12-04 and 2019-12-09 official release lineage, with the latest eligible release selected by cut.

errors_or_gaps_in_current_calendar.finding: The admitted config has no 2026 year table even though the official 2026 schedule was published on 2025-12-23.
errors_or_gaps_in_current_calendar.repair_needed: Add the 2025-12-23 official 2026 release; keep post-observation dates separate from dates actually covered by acquired data.

errors_or_gaps_in_current_calendar.finding: The current config explicitly claims transcribed official facts but retains no raw official HTML/PDF bytes or hashes.
errors_or_gaps_in_current_calendar.repair_needed: For a stronger admitted reference, retain immutable official page/PDF bytes or a separately governed capture; until then, URLs and publication dates are the primary citations and the byte-level source claim remains open.

errors_or_gaps_in_current_calendar.finding: The cash calendar does not certify CME Globex, futures venue boundaries, broker cutoffs, or vendor receipt/completeness. It also does not establish the latest acquired 2026 observation date.
errors_or_gaps_in_current_calendar.repair_needed: Use this extension only as a cash RTH context gate and resolve futures, source-coverage, and actual-data-cut evidence separately before admitting a Jumbo cohort.

current_config_assessment.reason_latest_date_unknown: This read-only evidence task did not scan market data or infer data coverage from filenames.
